correctness.rationale: Uniform Dirichlet spacings equal normalized iid Exp(1). Triangle viability is exactly the independent event Y_(i+2)<E_(i); Laplace transform produces the exact factorial ratio. A strict integer one-switch adjacent-ratio comparison proves the unique optimizer, and uniform Stirling at m=n/3+O(1) gives \(\sqrt6(3/4)^n\) with relative \(O(n^{-1})\). Exact checker tests rational identities in all integer sizes \(3\le n\le100\) and asymptotic ratios.
